purpose: 对照实验：检验'发表工作区的均匀网格候选（含真值近邻）摊薄真滤波器概率'这一机制假说（multiseed Level B 第一层审查的待验证推断）
trigger: layer-1 review of matlab_multiseed_params_v01 discovered the published workspace candidates are exact linspace grids, invalidating the same-design-point reading of the rng(1) reference

settings.identical_to: matlab_multiseed_params_v01 driver in every respect EXCEPT candidate generation
settings.candidates: deterministic linspace(lower, upper, 10) per parameter (exact published-workspace grid) + truth phase-1 and phase-2 rows; no lhsdesign calls, no burned draws (RNG stream = noise draws only)
settings.noise: 1e-6*diag([140,1000,4,1200,0]) truth draws and all 12 filter ProcessNoise; r=1.5e-5

frozen_prediction.mechanism: 网格含真值近邻（cw 611.1↔600 / 388.9↔400；cq 3.11↔3 / 5.89↔6），近重复候选摊薄真滤波器概率
frozen_prediction.if_mechanism_true: 网格对照的阶段 1/2 真滤波器平均概率分布应明显低于 LHS 24 种子分布（其 min 0.349/0.462），并把发表参考值 0.333/0.365 覆盖在自身分布之内或近旁
frozen_prediction.if_mechanism_false: 网格对照分布与 LHS 分布相近，发表参考仍然离群——则参考异常另有原因，如实报告
frozen_prediction.no_pass_fail_gate: 描述性对照，无通过/失败门；结论按上述两支路径如实归类，不新增中间档

summary: same anchor implementation and quantile rules as matlab_multiseed_params_v01 (matlab_multiseed_summary.py); published reference anchors listed alongside both distributions
